title: ICE Operations in Minneapolis
subtitle: Contact your representatives about federal enforcement accountability

urgentBanner.text: The Senate is voting on a government funding package that requires 60 votes to pass. Key Democrats have pledged to vote against DHS funding unless restrictions are placed on immigration enforcement operations. Contact your Senators NOW — they have the power to demand accountability through the budget process.

contentBlocks.label: Renee Macklin Good shooting (Jan 7)
contentBlocks.contextText: On January 7th, 2025, ICE agent Jonathan Ross shot and killed Renee Macklin Good in Minneapolis.
contentBlocks.templateFragment: On January 7th, ICE agent Jonathan Ross shot and killed Renee Macklin Good.

contentBlocks.label: Alex Pretti shooting (Jan 25)
contentBlocks.contextText: On January 25th, a federal agent shot and killed Alex Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse, in Minneapolis' Whittier neighborhood. This is the second fatal shooting by federal agents in Minnesota in less than three weeks.
contentBlocks.templateFragment: On January 25th, a federal agent shot and killed Alex Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse.

contentBlocks.label: Roosevelt High School vehicle pursuit
contentBlocks.contextText: A vehicle pursuit ended in front of Roosevelt High School with approximately 15 students and staff present, resulting in arrests.
contentBlocks.templateFragment: A vehicle pursuit ended in front of Roosevelt High School with students and staff present.

contentBlocks.label: Peaceful protests mischaracterized as riots
contentBlocks.contextText: Thousands of Minnesotans have peacefully protested these actions, with over 100 organizations calling for accountability. Despite peaceful protests, federal officials have falsely characterized these gatherings as riots.
contentBlocks.templateFragment: Meanwhile, thousands of Minnesotans have peacefully protested these actions, yet federal officials falsely characterize these gatherings as riots.

tones.label: Democrat Rep
tones.subject: URGENT: Vote NO on DHS Funding - Demand Accountability for Minnesota Deaths
asks: Prosecution of the agents responsible for these deaths
Congressional investigation into DHS enforcement practices
tones.closing:
Our communities deserve safety and dignity, not fear and violence.

Thank you for your leadership on this critical issue.

tones.label: Moderate Republican
tones.subject: Vote Against DHS Funding Without Enforcement Restrictions
tones.intro:
I am writing to you as a constituent deeply concerned about federal enforcement operations in Minneapolis. Regardless of one's views on immigration policy, I believe we can agree that recent events represent a serious breakdown in operational judgment.

{selected_blocks}

The Senate is currently voting on a government funding package. I respectfully urge you to support your colleagues who are demanding restrictions on enforcement operations before approving DHS funding. This is not about blocking immigration enforcement — it's about ensuring it's conducted safely and with proper oversight.

You have a concrete opportunity right now to:
asks: Demand operational review and new protocols
Tie funding to community safety standards
tones.closing:
Effective enforcement must balance security with community trust and basic human dignity.

Thank you for considering my concerns.

tones.label: Far Right Rep
tones.subject: Request DHS Funding Restrictions to Ensure Operational Standards
tones.intro:
I am writing regarding federal enforcement operations in Minneapolis. While I understand the importance of immigration enforcement, recent events merit serious review of operational protocols.

{selected_blocks}

The Senate is voting on a government funding package. I ask that you support efforts to ensure DHS funding includes clear operational restrictions. This is about maintaining professional standards and community stability, not blocking enforcement.

Strong enforcement requires:
asks: Clear protocols that protect both officers and community members
Operations that don't escalate near schools or create unnecessary conflict
tones.closing:
Effective enforcement achieves its goals while maintaining public trust and order.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.
